This occupancy remasurement of the already-named G24 identifier is very nearly clean: subject custody is intact at fb0a14c5...b5b9d399 mode 0444, all 41 cited digests reproduce against live bytes, the live G24 harness cell and every other quoted register cell reproduce character-exact from file 08 line 360, the three live-cell members map one-to-one onto three retained-evidence records each carrying exactByteIntent and passProperty, all eight DR-131 NT classes route correctly across D-148 through D-154 without inventing a number, g24-leftover-join.v3 (D-199) is cited as the current G24 leftover-join with its leftoverDesign roster ['OBL-G24-FX-AUTHORING'] reproduced unflipped, OBL-G24-HARNESS-SPEC closure is attributed to D-199 rather than to this file existing, the INPUT basis is g24-input-corpus.v1 as leftover-join.v3 measured it, parentReview is the D-150 dual CONSENT 0/0 naming act and not naming v6, basedOn.d223.role is last-heading custody only with no leftover-join lineage and no G23 occupancy claim, and frozen v1 is held historical at HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26 and is not recorded as current. Live required-now is 28 — the subject's own requiredNowUnchanged says 28, its own failsIf names 'live required-now is claimed other than 28' as a failure condition, the leftover-join.v3 it consumes carries 28, and COORD line 7141 records 28. The sentence is a stale carry-over from frozen v1, which measured 26 at HEAD 5d5d778; the author updated requiredNowUnchanged and failsIf to the 28 form but left this one string behind. It is not house form either: the sibling G23 occupancy v2 recorded at D-223 carries the corrected sentence 'Does not change live required-now 28.' A remasurement that exists to measure at live HEAD after file 08 cardinality 28 cannot carry the superseded cardinality in its own refusal roster, where a recorder reading that line alone would carry 26 forward as live. The repair is one string. Do not record this v2 as G24 occupancy. Do not pin it. The subject was not edited and stays frozen at 0444 for the author to supersede.
